**Research Director**, [Statistics Norway](https://www.ssb.no/en/forskning/ansatte/linda-nostbakken)

**Professor of Economics**, [Norwegian School of Economics (NHH)](https://www.nhh.no/en/employees/faculty/linda-nostbakken/)

I am an economist specializing in environmental and natural resource economics. My research examines the use and management of natural resources and the environment, with a focus on marine resource management, land use policy, and the energy transition.

I am Associate Editor of [*Marine Resource Economics*](https://www.journals.uchicago.edu/journals/mre/about) and serve on the editorial board of [*Review of Environmental Economics and Policy*](https://www.journals.uchicago.edu/journals/reep/about). I am President of the [European Association of Environmental and Resource Economists](https://www.eaere.org/) (EAERE) for 2026–2027 and a board member of the [Research Council of Norway](https://www.forskningsradet.no/en/).
